---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    page-layout: full
---

<div id="network" style="height: 85vh; border: 1px solid #ddd;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
async function loadGraph() {
  const res = await fetch("https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph");
  const data = await res.json();

  // Build node map from API nodes
  const nodeMap = new Map();

  (data.nodes || []).forEach(n => {
    nodeMap.set(n.id, {
      id: n.id,
      label: n.alias || n.id
    });
  });

  // Ensure all edge endpoints exist as nodes (fixes GB7CAM error)
  (data.edges || []).forEach(e => {
    if (!nodeMap.has(e.source)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.source, { id: e.source, label: e.source });
    }
    if (!nodeMap.has(e.target)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.target, { id: e.target, label: e.target });
    }
  });

  const nodes = new vis.DataSet(Array.from(nodeMap.values()));

  const edges = new vis.DataSet(
    (data.edges || []).map((e, i) => ({
      id: i,
      from: e.source,
      to: e.target,
      label: e.quality ? String(e.quality) : "",
      arrows: "to"
    }))
  );

  const container = document.getElementById("network");

  const options = {
    nodes: {
      shape: "dot",
      size: 10,
      font: { size: 12 }
    },
    edges: {
      color: "#999",
      smooth: true
    },
    physics: {
      stabilization: true
    }
  };

  new vis.Network(container, { nodes, edges }, options);
}

loadGraph();
</script>
